hooks.command: in=$(cat); [ "$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = "true" ] && exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null; out=$(PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make check 2>&1) || jq -nc --arg o "$out" '{systemMessage:"make check failed", decision:"block", reason:("`make check` failed — fix before finishing:\n" + $o)}'; exit 0
